北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天晴，体感寒冷，请务必多穿衣物，谨防感冒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels freezing with strong winds. Bundle up warmly to stay healthy!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光明媚，微风送爽，体感舒适，记得享受好天气！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi enjoys sunshine and a pleasant breeze. What a lovely day!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温宜人，湿度适中，出行不必担心！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy with mild temperatures. Enjoy your day!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，暖意融融，体感舒适，注意补水，保持活力！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm. Stay hydrated and energetic!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，天气暖和，体感舒适，适合户外活动，注意防晒！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is warm and pleasant. A great day for outdoor activities, remember sun protection!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，风力稍大，体感略凉，出门记得添件薄外套！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with a moderate breeze, feeling a bit cool. Bring a light jacket!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有霾，风力较大，气温偏凉，请注意防霾保暖哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has haze, it's cool with moderate winds. Take precautions against haze and stay warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温微凉，湿度较高，出门注意防潮保暖！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and cool with high humidity. Stay warm and mind the dampness!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，气温偏凉，注意防霾保暖，保持心情愉快！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, it's cool. Take precautions against haze and stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，气温较低，体感寒冷，出门记得多穿点哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels cold. Remember to dress warmly!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，能见度低，气温微凉，请注意交通安全和保暖！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, visibility is low. Drive safely and stay warm!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴冷，体感极寒，风力较大，务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but extremely cold and windy. Bundle up and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感温度低，风力较大，外出请注意防寒保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and feels cold with moderate winds. Dress warmly when going out!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温舒适，微风拂面，是个轻松惬意的好日子！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and pleasant with a gentle breeze. Enjoy your relaxing day!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，气温温暖，湿度较高，出行请注意安全哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy and warm with high humidity. Please take care when traveling!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，风力 7级，体感寒冷，请务必注意防风保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels freezing with strong winds (level 7). Please stay warm and protected!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感温度较低，风力较大，外出记得多穿衣！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels cold with moderate winds. Dress warmly when going out!
